title: lifefrom-units: lab unit normalisation and sourced conversion
description: lifefrom-units normalises the unit strings printed on clinical laboratory results and converts values between units. Unit-arithmetic factors are derived; analyte-specific factors (molar masses from PubChem and CIAAW, ion charges, published NHANES factors, the IFCC-NGSP HbA1c master equation) carry a cited source; conversions that must not be done by default (for example lipoprotein(a) mg/dL to nmol/L, insulin µIU/mL to pmol/L) are refused with a reason; callers may supply their own factor, which is recorded. Values with comparators or flags (<5, 5.4 H) keep their qualifier. Spellings that mean different units in different languages ("mil/mm3": thousand in Spanish, million in English) are refused unless the caller names the report's language. One JSON specification is shared by a Python package and a TypeScript package that pass the same 1,670 test vectors.
